description: Laravel-specific rules, loaded automatically for repositories with stack php-laravel.

rules.title: Raw SQL binds every value
rules.check: DB::raw/selectRaw/whereRaw/statement calls pass every variable as a binding.

rules.title: Mass assignment guarded
rules.check: New models/fields use $fillable or explicit assignment; request data is validated before create/update.

rules.title: Multi-table writes in a transaction
rules.check: Writes to more than one table in one operation run inside DB::transaction with row locks where they read-then-write.

rules.title: Migrations are reversible
rules.check: Every migration in the plan has a working down() or the plan says why not.
